Reducing poverty and inequality would help to alleviate suffering, improve access to education, healthcare, and other basic needs, and promote social justice and equality.
2. Address climate change: Climate change is one of the most pressing environmental challenges of our time, and it is causing widespread damage to our planet. 5. Improve global health: The world faces numerous health challenges, including the spread of infectious diseases, mental health issues, and access to healthcare. Improving global health would require investments in healthcare infrastructure, research and development, and the promotion of healthy lifestyles.
